source.note: B proofs executed at the B tested head; W11 campaign-backed rows cite the campaign commit whose production src/ subtree is identical; A-owned rows cite the unmerged A-W12 branch head.

checklist.requirement: Driver online/offline lifecycle with version fencing and durable events
checklist.limitation: No authenticated actor; see SEC-AUTH-01.

checklist.requirement: Location accepted and discoverable through the derived Redis projection
checklist.limitation: Redis is a derived projection, never reservation authority.

checklist.requirement: Matching happy path: deterministic candidates -> one exact reservation
checklist.limitation: B leg (Matching reserve + Driver commit) PASS. The full end-to-end ride also needs A's Saga and C's Payment consumer, which are outside this B scope; no full FUN-05 PASS is claimed.

checklist.requirement: Matching no-Driver terminal with durable result intent
checklist.limitation: Trip consumption of MatchingFailedV1 is exercised by A/W9 intake tests, not re-proven here.

checklist.requirement: N Trips contend for one Driver; exactly one winner
checklist.authorityChecked: driver_db row locks + unique reservation index
checklist.limitation: Measured on disposable PostgreSQL; no benchmark claim.

checklist.requirement: GoOffline vs Reserve: both legal schedules preserve one winner and one intent
checklist.limitation: W11 campaign rerun on W12 source is recorded in w11-critical-regression.txt.

checklist.requirement: Stale compensation must not free a newer reservation
checklist.authorityChecked: driver_db + exact token fencing + real RabbitMQ
checklist.limitation: Late release is rejected and receipted; no reservation identity change.

checklist.requirement: Cancel vs Reserve in flight preserves terminal state and exact cleanup
checklist.authorityChecked: Trip DB (A authority) + Driver exact release fencing
checklist.limitation: A-owned proof on the unmerged A-W12 branch; B's release half is re-verified by AUD-04/07 on B's head.

checklist.requirement: Duplicate Matching execution/redelivery produces one effect and one terminal
checklist.limitation: Transport is at-least-once; the claim is stable identity, not exactly-once delivery.

checklist.requirement: Reserve response lost after Driver commit: UNKNOWN, no advance, same-R reconcile
checklist.limitation: Post-commit response-loss and same-R reconciliation are proven over real HTTP, but the production Matching runtime has no caller of ExecuteRoundAsync/ReconcileAsync: reconciliation is invoked by the Testing-only seam. Unattended recovery is NOT IMPLEMENTED (B-REC-01).

checklist.requirement: Matching crash after remote reserve commit: persisted attempt survives and recovers same R
checklist.proofName: W11 five-pass campaign REL-02 (SIGKILL, exit 137, restart); CrashAfterReserveRecoveryTests
checklist.limitation: SIGKILL/restart, persisted IN_FLIGHT and same-R reconcile are proven, but the recovery trigger is the Testing-only reconcile endpoint; no production restart/redelivery trigger exists. Unattended recovery is NOT IMPLEMENTED (B-REC-01).

checklist.requirement: Cancel vs unknown reservation cleanup converges to one terminal outcome
checklist.limitation: A-owned Trip cleanup proof on the unmerged A-W12 branch; B's exact release is independently re-verified.

checklist.requirement: Stale Driver-state projection event cannot regress authority
checklist.limitation: Projection receipts are derived Redis state; Driver remains authoritative.

checklist.requirement: Stale location cannot regress sequence, timestamp, coordinates or GEO
checklist.limitation: Exact replays are stale by the frozen W4 contract (documented, not a regression).

checklist.requirement: Redis unavailable degrades without fabricating candidates/reservations, then reconnects
checklist.authorityChecked: real Redis container + TCP gate + production candidate path
checklist.limitation: No automatic full projection rebuild is claimed; event-driven reconstruction is separate.

checklist.requirement: Exclusive Driver reservation (<=1 current active reservation/trip)
checklist.limitation: Auditor PASS on real scenario final states; CON-01 is the contention proof.

checklist.requirement: Driver state coherence (AVAILABLE/OFFLINE carry no refs; RESERVED needs exact refs; ON_TRIP needs active trip)
checklist.limitation: Null matching-round on legacy RESERVED rows is reported as a provenance gap, not a coherence failure.

checklist.requirement: OCC/version fence prevents stale overwrite and lost reservation
checklist.limitation: Reserve/online/offline linearize on the locked Driver row.

checklist.requirement: Exact-token release fencing: stale/foreign release cannot free a newer reservation
checklist.limitation: Release carries no version; token equality on the locked fresh row is the guard.

checklist.requirement: Same-reservation reserve replay is idempotent with one effect
checklist.limitation: Same-R replay returns canonical success before the version fence.

checklist.requirement: Location ordering: stale sequence/timestamp cannot regress
checklist.limitation: Session ownership and monotonic sequence are enforced in the projection.

checklist.requirement: Driver-state projection ordering cannot regress version
checklist.limitation: Derived projection only; Driver DB remains authority.

checklist.requirement: No second/contradictory terminal result for one matching round
checklist.limitation: Terminal state and MatchingFailedV1 intent commit atomically.

checklist.requirement: Current-round guard: stale round cannot apply to an advanced Trip
checklist.authorityChecked: Trip DB (A) + Driver outbox round provenance (B)
checklist.limitation: A-owned Trip proof; B's W08 lineage hardening supplies the exact round on DriverReservedV1. Source SHAs differ (A branch unmerged).

checklist.requirement: No candidate advance on UNKNOWN
checklist.limitation: UNKNOWN is a stop state until same-R reconciliation is conclusive.

checklist.requirement: One logical reserve attempt = one reservation identity
checklist.limitation: Cross-round identity reuse is also blocked by the unique index.

checklist.requirement: Deterministic candidate snapshot/order across replay and Redis churn
checklist.limitation: Snapshot is offered candidate sequence, not a live re-read.

checklist.requirement: Eligibility before ranking: stale/reserved/far/foreign candidates excluded
checklist.limitation: Eligibility uses the frozen snapshot; Redis is not authority.

checklist.requirement: Stage monotonicity S0 -> S1 -> S2; restart reloads current stage
checklist.proofName: No executable proof: current_stage persists and remains the schema default 'S0'; no S0->S1->S2 transition implementation or test exists
checklist.limitation: B-owned evidence gap: the current serial-candidate design has no multi-stage transition, so the invariant is vacuous in implementation but unproven. Requires lead disposition; it is not filled with PASS.

checklist.requirement: No candidate/stage advance on UNKNOWN
checklist.limitation: With a single S0 stage, this is expressed as no attempt/candidate advance until reconcile.

checklist.requirement: No endless fresh retry for a conclusively rejected candidate in the same round
checklist.limitation: Bounded reserve/reconcile budgets are explicit and tested.

checklist.requirement: Cancel vs Reserve terminal/cleanup agreement across Trip and Driver
checklist.limitation: A-owned cancellation proof; B's audit re-checks exact final agreement on B's scenarios.

checklist.requirement: UNKNOWN reservation recovery keeps one durable attempt/identity
checklist.limitation: AVAILABLE is conclusive only when the Driver version exceeds every dispatched fence.

checklist.requirement: Compensation uses exact trip/reservation/round fencing and cannot release a newer owner
checklist.authorityChecked: driver_db + Outbox + real broker + Trip cleanup intent
checklist.limitation: Release completion is read from the Driver authority, not from command ACK.

checklist.requirement: UNKNOWN reserve eventually resolves or becomes visibly terminal, with no silent stall
checklist.proofName: W11 five-pass REL-01/02; B12 AUD-08 quiescence policy (fresh pending vs stuck unresolved)
checklist.authorityChecked: real containers + driver/matching Outbox and attempt ages
checklist.limitation: No automatic eventual resolution: an UNKNOWN/IN_FLIGHT attempt is resolved only by the Testing reconcile seam; AUD-08 detects stale rows (FAIL) but does not resolve them. Liveness is PARTIAL (B-REC-01).

checklist.requirement: Matching round reaches a terminal or visibly blocked state without losing the winner identity
checklist.proofName: W11 five-pass REL-02; CrashAfterReserveRecoveryTests; ReserveWorkflowTests.Restart_Resumes_Same_Reservation_Identity; B12 AUD-06
checklist.limitation: Unattended recovery worker is not claimed; recovery is explicit and durable.

architecturalProhibitions.limitation: Round, attempt and reservation identity persist in matching_db; process restart reloads the same ledger.

architecturalProhibitions.prohibition: No Redis promotion to reservation authority
architecturalProhibitions.limitation: Redis outage degrades candidates with zero fabricated reservations; Driver DB remains authority.
UNKNOWN stops the round; no further Driver call or attempt row.
Retries reuse the same reservationId; reuse across ordinals fails loud.

architecturalProhibitions.prohibition: No terminal Matching state without durable result intent
architecturalProhibitions.proofName: MatchingTerminalOutboxTests (atomic commit, rollback, replay repair); B12 AUD-06
architecturalProhibitions.limitation: NO_DRIVER and MatchingFailedV1 commit atomically; rollback tests cover insert failure.

architecturalProhibitions.prohibition: No late Release affecting a newer reservation
architecturalProhibitions.limitation: Exact-token fencing rejects the stale release; the newer reservation and version survive.

architecturalProhibitions.proofName: B12 AUD-08 (stuck pending/unresolved/processing detection); MatchingOutboxRelayTests; DriverEventPublishTests; Trip W9/W10 outbox/saga tests (A-owned)
architecturalProhibitions.limitation: B-owned Driver/Matching unresolved states are aged and detected; Trip Saga/Outbox is A-owned and covered by A's auditor PASS.

overallResult: FAIL/BLOCKED — SEC-AUTH-01 CRITICAL remains open; B-REC-01 production reserve/reconcile trigger absent; DSI-021 evidence NOT RUN
scopeNotes: PASS includes 4 A-owned rows (CON-05, REL-03, DSI-016, DSI-030) cited from the unmerged A-W12 branch and not re-executed by B; B re-verifies only its release half through AUD-04/07.
REL-01/REL-02/DSL-001 are PARTIAL: the recovery logic is proven under the Testing-only harness; the production Matching runtime has no reserve execution or unattended reconcile trigger (B-REC-01).

bOwnedGaps.summary: Production Matching reserve/reconcile trigger absent; no caller of ExecuteRoundAsync/ReconcileAsync outside Testing endpoints; unattended recovery NOT IMPLEMENTED.
Stage monotonicity S0->S1->S2 is not implemented; current_stage is always S0; requires lead disposition or W13 implementation.
